items.title: Will DoorDash’s (DASH) Brand Center and Retail Alliances Redefine Its Platform Beyond Restaurant Delivery?

items.title: Lyft Dropped 30% in One Year: One Pro Analyst Says It’s Going to Double in the Next 12 Months
items.summary: Lyft's stock keeps falling even as its bookings and cash flow grow stronger, and one analyst sees a full double from here while 29 others are still waiting for proof. The gap between those two views tells you everything about what this stock is betting on.
